title: Destroying components immediately is not permitted during physics trigger/contact, animation event callbacks, rendering
notes: Fix 2026-11-20 by claude (dedc985d2a): MantaDecoyCrystal.Spawn strips the copy with DestroyImmediate, which Unity refuses inside OnTriggerEnter, so the decoy kept its gameplay parts. MantaStingActionExecutor.LeaveDecoy queues the decoy and Update builds it later in the same frame.
